blocks.text: Couples Spa & Couples Massage at Elements
blocks.html: Couples Spa & Couples Massage at Elements

At Elements, we offer shared experiences that bring people closer. Our couples spa and couples massage treatments are thoughtfully designed for two—so you and your partner can unwind, rejuvenate, and relax together in a peaceful space built for shared experiences.

Enjoy side-by-side massages in the same room, each tailored to your individual preferences— whether you and your partner favor different techniques or pressure levels, our therapists ensure both of you have a relaxing and customized experience.

Starts from $195 per couple.

Unwind together in a private Japanese Onsen, then melt into side-by-side massage therapy that soothes the body and calms the mind—your perfect escape for connection and relaxation.

Includes:
• Body Massage (60-min)
• Back Scrub (15-min)
• Koyamaki Onsen Therapy in Private Suite (40-min)
• Couple Massage Room
Enjoy complete privacy in a room with two individual tubs — ideal for couples or friends. Each person selects a personalized herbal blend to match their wellness needs.

Experience the power of contrast therapy together—stay motivated through the cold plunge, regulate your breath as a team, and then unwind side by side with a relaxing massage. It’s the perfect balance of recovery, connection, and deep relaxation.
